$comment: HUSO study schedule 12 Oct - 15 Nov 2026 (plan v2, issue #33). Source of truth for the app seeder. subject: a slug from syllabus.json, or diagnostic|mixed|prep|exam. blocks[].subtopics lists the subtopic slugs studied in that block; each of the 76 appears exactly once, the last on 2026-11-07. Checked by scripts/check_plan.py.

readiness.definition: A subtopic is READY when (1) its material was read and its diagram redrawn from memory, (2) its Check your understanding has 4/5 or more correct, and (3) its flashcards are in Leitner box 3 or higher by 8 Nov (or its mastery is 70+ on the syllabus map).

blocks.label: Setup
tasks: Get a sketchbook, 5 colored markers (one per subject) and sticky notes
Set up the paper Leitner box (or Anki) until the app is ready
Put the 12 Oct - 15 Nov tracker calendar on the wall
Start the error log page

tasks: Mathematics 36 minutes

Biology 36 minutes

blocks.label: Correct and analyze
tasks: Score each subject: correct - 0.25 x wrong
Draw a bar chart of the 5 subject scores
Mark the weakest subtopics; they get extra time later
Pick your best 4 subjects (best-four rule) and note the decision
